card.name: Xianzi
card.tagline: Tibetan string-instrument circle dance with flowing sleeves
card.profile: Xianzi (also Xie, Tibetan sgor gzhas) is a Tibetan folk song-and-dance in which men play a two-stringed instrument (the xianzi/biwang) while women dance in circles waving long sleeves (CGTN; China Culture). The best-known form is Batang Xianzi from Batang County, Garzê, Sichuan; movements are slow and graceful, forming winding 'dragon' formations. Lyrics are poetic records of local life dating back over 1,000 years.
card.insight: Batang Xianzi was inscribed in 2006 in China's first batch of national intangible cultural heritage and is called a 'living fossil' of Tibetan song and dance (CGTN).
